mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 79 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall, though the air quality index is at 59.
The City of Verona is offering a rain barrel rebate program to help manage stormwater, and they are also hiring seasonal recreation staff.

Today, you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, or Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market this Friday.
Regarding the weekly report, on Thursday, July 31st, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for O W I and driving with suspended registration.
Today's featured flavor is the Chocolate Caramel Twist, available until the shop closes at 10 PM. You can also catch Kona Ice today at Fireman's Park from 11 AM to 4 PM.
